description: The file defines a Java interface for managing and enforcing connection limits within a service, specifically providing a method to check if the connection limit is exceeded.

classes.name: ConnectionLimitManager
classes.description: An interface that enforces an upper limit of concurrent connections and provides a method to check if this limit has been exceeded.

methods.name: isLimitExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the current number of connections has reached or exceeded the allowed limit and returns true if so.
